behavioral_notes.observation: Sending is asynchronous: action_launch sets schedule_type='now' then action_put_in_queue writes state='in_queue' and triggers the ir_cron_mass_mailing_queue cron (cron._trigger at schedule_date). The cron's _process_mass_mailing_queue picks mailings in ('in_queue','sending'), sets state='sending', and calls _action_send_mail, which builds a mail.compose.message in composition_mode='mass_mail' and calls composer._action_send_mail(auto_commit=True). Mails are produced into the standard mail.mail outgoing queue; not visible in metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: mailing.trace open/click tracking (mail_mail._prepare_outgoing_body, controllers track_mail_open + full_url_redirect)
behavioral_notes.observation: mail.mail._prepare_outgoing_body injects an HMAC-tokened 1x1 tracking pixel (/mail/track/<mail_id>/<token>/blank.gif) and rewrites /r/<code> short links to add the trace id (.../m/<trace_id>). The public pixel route calls mailing.trace.set_opened; the /r/<code>/m/<trace_id> redirect calls link.tracker.click.add_click which (via add_click override) fires trace.set_opened + set_clicked, then 301-redirects to the real URL. Open/click semantics live entirely in code + link_tracker, not metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: mailing.trace reply/bounce via incoming mail gateway (mail_thread._message_route_process / _routing_handle_bounce)
behavioral_notes.observation: Inbound replies matched by References/Message-ID call mailing.trace.set_opened + set_replied; bounce notifications call mailing.trace.set_bounced. An auto-blacklist rule blacklists an address after >=5 bounces in 13 weeks (separated by >1 week) by calling mail.blacklist._add. Statuses (sent/delivered/open/reply/bounce/error/cancel) are mutated by mailing.trace.set_* helpers.

A/B variants share a utm.campaign; each gets ab_testing_pc (% of audience). The winner is chosen by ab_testing_winner_selection (e.g. opened/clicked/replied ratio, or manual); action_send_winner_mailing sorts sent siblings by that metric and action_select_as_winner copies the winner at 100% and launches it. A campaign-level cron sends the winner at ab_testing_schedule_datetime.

behavioral_notes.element: Blacklist / unsubscribe / opt-out (controllers main.py, mailing.contact, mailing.subscription)
behavioral_notes.observation: Recipient-specific HMAC-signed unsubscribe/view URLs and List-Unsubscribe / List-Unsubscribe-Post one-click headers are injected per email in mail_mail._prepare_outgoing_list. List-based mailings opt-out via mailing.subscription (opt_out + opt_out_reason_id); document/blacklist mode adds the address to mail.blacklist via _add. mailing.contact.opt_out is a per-list computed/searched flag, not a stored column.

behavioral_notes.element: external integrations (manifest website URL, requests SDK in models/mailing.py)
behavioral_notes.observation: Outbound HTTP is not a marketing-API call: models/mailing.py imports `requests` and uses requests.Session() only in _convert_inline_images_to_urls to fetch image bytes by URL for VML/responsive cropping when preparing email bodies. The manifest exposes the product page https://www.odoo.com/app/email-marketing. Email delivery itself goes out via SMTP through ir.mail_server (mail_server_id; mass-mail servers filtered to those without owner_user_id), and open/click/bounce tracking is driven by inbound HTTP pixels/redirects and the incoming mail gateway rather than a third-party ESP SDK.

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: mass_mailing is a value-network mediating activity: it connects the organization to a large audience at scale, brokering the relationship through mediating infrastructure (mailing lists/subscriptions, SMTP delivery, UTM campaigns, open/click/bounce tracking). Per Stabell & Fjeldstad the network firm's primary activities are network promotion & contract management, service provisioning, and infrastructure operation — mass-emailing recruits and serves a contact network rather than transforming inputs (chain) or solving a client problem (shop). It is the marketing broadcast primary activity, mapping to APQC 3.0 Market and Sell (3.3 Develop and manage marketing plans / 3.4 Develop and manage marketing communications). Its utm + link_tracker dependencies wire campaign attribution back into the value network.
